releases.name: v0.18.6 — Worker False-Positive Closure & Actionable Completion Gate
releases.body:
### Fixed
- **Worker Session False-Positive Elimination & Actionable `task/completion-gate` Remediation (223 live worker sessions `opencode.db` audit):**
  - **Verification Evidence (`src/evidence.ts`):**
    - Extended clean `| tail -N` (`N >= 2`) / `tee` passthrough confirmation to **`lint`** (alongside `typecheck` and `build`) with fail-closed lint warning/error count detection (`Found N warnings/errors`, `✖ N problems`).
    - Extended `parseExitStatusEchoStage` to accept multi-word quoted exit-status echo labels (`echo "lint exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"`, `echo "lint exit: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"`, `echo "typecheck exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"`, `echo "build exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"`) so live exit echoes are recognized and never misclassified as output spoofing stages (still rejecting hardcoded `=0` literals and promoting non-zero `=1` captures to `"failure"`).
    - Recognized `git stash` (`push`/`pop`/`apply`/`save`, excluding `git stash list`) as `"baseline"` evidence.
  - **Actionable Completion Gate & Policy-Refusal Filtering (`src/rules/task-completion.ts`):**
    - Included concrete unresolved `blocking` finding details (`pattern` + truncated snippet) inside `task/completion-gate` `remediationPrompt` so agents immediately see *which* execution failed instead of receiving an empty heading.
    - Treated read-only `read`/`grep` range and glob errors (`invalid_range`, `startLine ... is past the end`, `startLine ... is after endLine`, `no lines selected`, `search path does not exist`, `invalid include/exclude glob`) as benign read-only probe failures.
    - Filtered host/plugin policy refusals (`outside task <id> scope`, `outside the project boundary`, `write target is not inspectable`, `shell command rejected:`, `is not a known read-only tool`, `not in the read-only allowlist`, `is in planning phase; writes are disabled`), idempotent `newString is already present` edits, and retried `edit` JSON/line-range schema validation errors cleanly.
  - **Shortcuts, Evasion, Silent Failure, Test Integrity & Secrets Precision (`src/rules/no-shortcuts.ts`, `src/rules/no-evasion.ts`, `src/rules/no-silent-failure.ts`, `src/rules/no-cheat.ts`, `src/rules/no-secrets.ts`):**
    - Eliminated 76% of `quality/no-shortcuts` advisory noise across worker reports: exempted negated/clean-scan placeholder statements (`placeholder yok`/`yoktur`, `no placeholders`, `placeholder taraması temiz`, `placeholder/TODO/TBD scan clean`, `rather than ... placeholder`), technical sentinel/redaction placeholder terminology, past-tense `"temporary git stash was used"` / `"my first version failed"` references, and `"hard-coded"` golden test-fixture comments inside test files (while keeping active shortcuts blocked).
    - Supported `git stash` baseline reproductions in `discipline/no-evasion` for pre-existing failure claims (still blocking unproven claims).
    - Skipped Markdown/text documentation files (`*.md`/`*.txt`) and intentionally commented rollback/best-effort cleanup catches (`catch { // rollback ... } throw error`, `catch { // Best effort ... }`) in `integrity/no-silent-failure`.
    - Exempted `typeof` type-narrowing guards paired with unconditional sibling assertions from advisory `"conditional assertion"` warnings in `testing/no-cheat`.
    - Skipped rejected/errored tool calls (`part.state.status === "error"`) that never wrote to disk in `security/no-secrets`.
- **Verification:**
  - Added TDD regression suite `tests/live-2026-11-26-fp-closure.test.mjs`: **980 / 980** tests passing across 24 test files (`81` suites), **0** Oxlint warnings/errors across 76 files, strict TypeScript clean, **21 / 21** sandbox scenarios, **10 / 10** live OpenCode `v2.4.1` + Bun `1.4.4` acceptance checks, and full-day live replay across **223 real V2 worker sessions (`351` turns)** in `opencode.db`.

releases.name: v0.18.5 — Live Production False-Positive Closure
releases.body:
### Fixed
- **Live Production False-Positive Closure across Verification Evidence, Claims, Test Integrity, Shortcuts, and Completion Gate (`opencode.db` live V2 replay):**
  - **Compound & Piped Verification Evidence (`src/evidence.ts`):**
    - Confirmed per-segment live exit-status echoes (`echo TC=$?`, `echo BUILD=$?`, `echo EXIT ${PIPESTATUS[0]}`) as `"success"` on `<LABEL>=0` and promoted non-zero `<LABEL>=1` captures directly to `"failure"` (closing masked-failure blind spots while still rejecting hardcoded `echo TC=0` literals).
    - Recognized benign static markers (`echo TEST_DONE`, `echo "---"`), zero-output `; grep ...; echo grep=$?` (`grep=1`) stages, and clean `tail -N` (`N >= 2`) / `tee` passthrough on `typecheck` and `build` when zero compiler/build errors and zero AFT upstream pipeline failure notes appear (while still rejecting `tail -1`, `head`, and spoofing stages).
    - Made `splitTopLevelShellSegments` and `executableShellStages` heredoc-aware (`<<'EOF' ... EOF`), exempted silent stdout-redirected `cat >> file <<'EOF'` writes from spoofing detection, and preserved intra-command mutation-before-verification ordering so `cat >> test.mjs <<'EOF' ... EOF\nnpm run typecheck; npm run build; node --test ...` stays fresh while post-verification mutations (`npm run typecheck && echo x >> src/app.ts`) remain stale.
  - **Unverified Claims Precision (`src/rules/no-unverified-claims.ts`, `src/locale-intents.ts`):**
    - Fixed `gitStatusSemanticEvidence` to strip `[task bash-...]` harness trailers and match genuine git porcelain status lines only, eliminating false blocking contradictions on compound `git status --short --branch && echo '---LOG---' && git log` commands while still blocking dirty working trees.
    - Allowed non-compiled `.test.mjs`/`.spec.js` edits (including in-place `perl -pi`/`sed -i` test-file edits) without invalidating `typecheck`/`build`, supported qualified subset test claims (`"38 new/extended tests pass"` alongside transparent failure disclosure) and partial `X of Y` (`X < Y`) reports, ignored historical restatements (`"earlier report"`), recognized EN/TR verification delegation to manager (`"leave verification to manager"`, `"doğrulamayı yöneticiye devrediyorum"`), and accepted coordinator summaries of `<background-result>` / `subagent` verification when no local edits intervened.
  - **Test Integrity, Shortcuts & Completion Gate (`src/rules/no-cheat.ts`, `src/rules/no-shortcuts.ts`, `src/rules/task-completion.ts`):**
    - Exempted balanced `if (...) { assert... } else { assert... }` and guard-clause `if (...) { assert...; continue; } assert...;` loops from advisory `"conditional assertion"` findings.
    - Exempted context-pruned prompt placeholder reports (`"Only the placeholder survived"`) and neutral/sanitized test fixture reports (`"nötr placeholder"`) from `quality/no-shortcuts`.
    - Resolved non-shell structured tool retries (`subagent`, `todowrite`, `hi_task`, etc.), shell parameter-validation retries, `cd <sameDir> &&` retried commands, compound read-only existence probes (`ls -d`, `2>/dev/null`), and host/coordinator scope-policy refusals cleanly in `task/completion-gate`.
- **Verification:**
  - Added TDD regression suite `tests/live-production-fp-closure.test.mjs`: **973 / 973** tests passing across 23 test files (`80` suites), **0** Oxlint warnings/errors across 75 files, strict TypeScript clean, **21 / 21** sandbox scenarios, **10 / 10** live OpenCode `v2.4.1` + Bun `1.4.4` acceptance checks, and live replay across 31 real V2 worker sessions in `opencode.db` confirming **0** false positives across `integrity/no-unverified-claims`, `testing/no-cheat`, `quality/no-shortcuts`, and `task/completion-gate`.

## OpenCode Guardian v0.18.4

This release publishes both the **zero-race pre-idle inspection** introduced in `0.18.3` and the **full 6-pass adversarial debug sweep + live `opencode.db` V2 session replay hardening** in `0.18.4`.

### Highlights

- **Zero-Race Pre-Idle Inspection (`session.hook("experimental.idle")`):**
  - Inspects all 14 rules synchronously inside OpenCode V2's awaited `experimental.idle` hook before idle transition and before parent `<background-result>` delivery, so violating subagents remediate inside the same execution and deliver a single clean result to their parent/manager.
  - Preserves idempotent `event.subscribe` fallback for older hosts and refcounted per-session pre-inspection leases with prompt-arrival cancellation.
- **OpenCode v2.4.1 Real-World V2 Replay Hardening (80 real sessions, 206 turns, 2,971 tool calls):**
  - Added full support for OpenCode `v2.4.1` `edit` tool `appendContent` and `prependContent` fields across preflight, evidence mutation tracking, edit-integrity, and all code-inspection rules.
  - Eliminated false redactions on runtime RegExp metadata properties (`PEM_PRIVATE_KEY_REGEX.lastIndex = 0`) and Markdown inline-code prose tokens (``Standing authorization: `check` ``).
- **Universal Plugin Mesh (`src/bridge.ts`):**
  - Moved `rpcStandbyPromotions` onto `MeshGlobalState` (`Symbol.for("opencode.mesh.v2")`) for cross-bundle multi-plugin interoperability, kept host slots occupied during async dispose, and awaited triggered standby teardown inside the promotion promise.
- **Shell Risk, Preflight & Verification Evidence (`src/shell-risk.ts`, `src/preflight.ts`, `src/evidence.ts`):**
  - Replaced fragile `env` / `bash -c` / `env -S` regexes with token-aware parsers supporting ANSI-C `$'...'`, mixed/concatenated quotes, post-`-c` options (`-e`, `-o`, `-O`, `-eo`, `-`), `env -S` trailing argv & recursive `process_start` checks, combined `env` flags (`-iC`, `-iu`, `--ignore-signal=`, `-- VAR=VAL`), and case-sensitive `sudo`/`flock` flags (`-H`, `-P`, `-uroot`, `-Dtmp`, `-nD`, `-nu`, `flock -e`).
  - Stopped `process_start` option scanning at positional scripts (`bash evil.sh -c ...`, `pwsh -File evil.ps1 -Command ...`), caught inline eval flags (`node --eval=`/`--print=`/`--input-type`, `perl -e'...'`, `python3 -c<code>`), and eliminated false positives on standard attached-value interpreter flags (`python3 -Wonce`/`-Xtracemalloc`/`-mcoverage`, `ruby -rfileutils`/`-Ctmp`, `perl -Mfeature`/`-Iextra`, `node -Cdevelopment`).
  - Tracked subshell nesting depth (`(true; set -o pipefail); ...`, `{ (set -o pipefail); }; ...`), preserved case for `grep` passthrough flags (`-A`/`-B`/`-C`/`-E`/`-iA`/`-eerror`), rejected `grep -r`/`-R`/`--directories=recurse`/`head -n 0`, prevented duplicate same-kind `;` summary spoofing, and captured `sudo -D` / `env -iC` foreign working directories.
- **Multi-Layer Secret Redaction & All 14 Rules:**
  - Hardened dotted/parenthesized & optional-chaining call-argument secret detection (`SG.xxx.yyy`, `v4.local.xxx`, `Set-Cookie: session.xxx`, `MyPass(2024)`, `ab?.cd(mySecret2024)`), >2 MiB linear YAML & quote/delimiter-aware single-line chunking, `docker container exec` & `env -uNODE_ENV` env-dump preflight, single-pass heredoc/`printf`/`echo -n -e`/`2>` handling in `no-stubs`, scoped `git` `-m`/`-F`/`-u`/`-S` flags in `destructive-operations`, and `//` / `/* */` comment scanning inside `${...}` template interpolations in `no-ghost-deps` and `no-shortcuts`.

### Verification

- **Automated Tests:** `965 / 965` passing across 22 test files (`79` suites)
- **Static Gates:** `typecheck:strict` clean, `oxlint` `0 warnings, 0 errors` (74 files)
- **End-to-End Sandboxes:** `smoke-test` PASS, `comprehensive-test` `21 / 21` PASS, `v2-live-acceptance` `10 / 10` PASS (Node `v26.13.1`, Bun `1.4.4`, OpenCode `v2.4.1`)
- **Live Verification:** Real OpenCode `v2.4.1` standalone pre-idle remediation proof + live replay across 80 real V2 `opencode.db` sessions (`0` exceptions,

## What's Fixed in v0.18.2

### Verification Wrapper & Modern JS/TS Toolchain Recognition (`src/evidence.ts`)
- Unwraps benign POSIX command wrappers (`flock`, `timeout`, `nice`, `nohup`, `command`, `time`) and nested literal `sh`/`bash`/`zsh`/`dash -c '...'` (plus `flock <lock> -c '...'`) scripts in `executableShellStages` so locked/subshell verification commands are classified accurately instead of falling back to `"generic"`.
- Recognizes `node` with leading flags before `--test` (e.g. `node --import ./setup.mjs --test`), `oxlint`, `biome lint/check`, `prettier --check`, `stylelint`, `shellcheck`, plain `tsc` (excluding exploratory flags), and colon-suffixed npm/pnpm/yarn/bun scripts (`test:*`, `build:*`, `lint:*`, `typecheck:*`).
- Allows complete, anchored passing test-runner summaries (`parseTestSummary`) and anchored `oxlint` clean output (`Found 0 warnings and 0 errors.`) with exit code `0` to confirm verification even when piped to `tail`/`head`/`grep`/`tee` or chained via `;` with another verification stage, while rejecting any command containing output-spoofing stages (`echo`, `printf`, `cat`, `node -e`, etc.).

### Explicit `Do NOT run npm ...` / Backticked Verification Prohibitions (`src/locale-intents.ts`, `src/task-contract.ts`, `src/rules/no-unverified-claims.ts`)
- Preserves inline-backticked commands during prohibition extraction (`sanitizeForProhibitions`) and extends `deniedVerification` to recognize package-manager and script prohibitions (e.g. `Do NOT run \`npm run check\``, `not run npm test`, `skip npm run build`, `npm test çalıştırma`).
- Respects `prohibitedVerifications` in `integrity/no-unverified-claims` so honest fix statements do not emit false missing-verification warnings when verification was explicitly forbidden, while still flagging fabricated pass claims and failed-run contradictions.

### False-Positive Elimination & Unverified Remediation Mesh Retention
- Scopes `until` in `ITERATION`/`CONTINUE` (`src/locale-intents.ts`) to genuine loop termination clauses (`until no errors remain`, `until all tests pass`, `until clean`, etc.) so technical descriptions like *"denies writes until update adds paths"* never trigger false `task/completion-gate` iterative review loops.
- Exempts empty mock/test-double functions (`() => {}`, `async interrupt() {}`) inside test files (`tests/**`, `__tests__/**`, `*.test.*`, `*.spec.*`) from the empty-implementation stub check in `src/rules/no-stubs.ts`, keeping production stub enforcement 100% strict.
- Ignores past-tense/removed debug notes (e.g. *"A temporary debug log (since removed)..."*) for the bare `"temporary"` keyword in `src/rules/no-shortcuts.ts`, while keeping active `"temporary fix"` / `"temporary solution"` enforcement unchanged.
- Retains active `post-remediation` mesh intervention state in `src/index.ts` when `remediationStatus === "unverified"` involves code/security/verification rules or remaining findings, while clearing cleanly on prose-only passes.

### Verification
- **922 / 922** unit & regression tests passing across 15 domain suites (including `tests/live-false-positive-regressions.test.mjs`)
- **21 / 21** comprehensive sandbox scenarios passing
- **10 / 10** live OpenCode `v2.4.1` + Bun `1.4.4` host acceptance checks passing
- Strict TypeScript, Oxlint (`0 warnings / 0 errors` on 66 files), docs/SVG checks, and `npm audit --omit=dev` (`0 vulnerabilities`) all passing.

## OpenCode Guardian v0.18.1

Eliminates the post-turn orchestration race window with sibling V2 plugins, surfaces read-only subagent & failed-remediation findings across the Universal Plugin Mesh, and aligns cross-revision `claimDigest` provenance verification.

### Fixed
- **Synchronous Pre-Inspection `active_remediation` Lease (`src/index.ts`):**
  - Acquires a short-TTL (`10s`, `reason: "guardian-inspecting"`) `active_remediation` mesh lease synchronously on `session.execution.succeeded` / `session.idle` before `idleQueue` coalescing and async `session.context` fetching begin, closing the race window where sibling orchestrators could prematurely close a child task before Guardian finishes inspecting and dispatching remediation.
  - Releases the pre-inspection lease immediately on clean, skipped, aborted, read-only, or errored turns (and on human prompt, deletion, move, or disposal), and upgrades it seamlessly via `leaseToken` matching into the heartbeat-renewed `45s` `guardian-remediation` lease whenever remediation is dispatched.
  - Strictly preserves session lease priority (`user_interaction (30) > active_remediation (20) > orchestration_dispatch (10)`).
- **Read-Only Subagent & Failed-Remediation Mesh Visibility (`src/index.ts`):**
  - Publishes active `recordMeshIntervention` records when read-only / non-writable subagents trigger blocking findings (`kind: "post-warning"`) or when remediation fails (`kind: "post-remediation"`), allowing sibling orchestrators to surface unresolved policy state to managers without injecting self-remediation prompts into read-only children.
- **Cross-Revision Mesh Provenance Compatibility (`src/bridge.ts`):**
  - Writes and verifies both `claimDigest` (SHA-256 envelope claim digest) and legacy plain claim fields (`protected`, `sanitizedBy`, `boundedBy`, `taskID`, `requiredSkills`), ensuring seamless bidirectional provenance verification across all sibling V2 mesh plugins (`opencode-hi`, `opencode-trim`, `opencode-smart-questions`).

### Verification
- **914 / 914** automated tests passing across 14 domain suites (`Node 22.x`, `24.x`, `26.x`).
- **21 / 21** isolated end-to-end sandbox scenarios passing (`sandbox/comprehensive-test.mjs`).
- **10 / 10** live OpenCode `v2.4.1` + Bun `1.4.4` acceptance checks passing (`sandbox/v2-live-acceptance.mjs`), plus verified dual-plugin Guardian ↔ orchestrator E2E handshake.
- Strict TypeScript, Oxlint (`0 warnings / 0 errors` on 65 files), Markdown/SVG validation, production + dev dependency audits, and `npm pack --dry-run` all passing.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/huseyincig/opencode-guardian/compare/v0.18.0...v0.18.1
